title: Digital Marketing Assistant Manager
description:
What Sets Us Apart

At MHA, people come first, our colleagues, our clients, and the communities we support. Were ranked as number 11 in the UK s top accountancy firms and a proud member of Baker Tilly International, the world's 8th largest network, we combine global insight with a strong local commitment.

Our people-centred approach is what truly makes us different. You will be welcomed as a valued member of a collaborative, purpose-led team. We are committed to continuous learning, growth, and creating an environment where everyone can thrive.

We invest in our colleagues because they are the foundation of our shared success. With access to resources and award-winning development programmes, you will have the space to shape your career while making a real impact.

We are proud to hold the Investors in People Gold award, recognising our commitment to supporting, developing, and valuing every individual.

Here, You'll Go Beyond Numbers

We're looking for a Digital Marketing Assistant Manager who thrives on variety, enjoys a fast-moving environment, and wants their work to make a real difference

At MHA, you will be surrounded by passionate professionals who are committed to making a difference. Your work in Marketing will go beyond the numbers, it's about building trusted relationships, understanding their requirements, navigating risks, and delivering insights that support informed decision-making.

What You'll Be Doing

This is a position within the Digital Marketing team, reporting into the Senior Digital Marketing Manager. You will line manage junior members of the team, whilst helping to lead delivery across our four brands and their markets: MHA UK, Baker Tilly Ireland, Baker Tilly South East Europe and MHA UAE.

Leadership & people
- Support and develop junior members of the digital marketing team, holding regular one-to-ones and owning their appraisals and development.
- Review work and provide timely, constructive feedback.
- Plan and allocate work with the Senior Digital Marketing Manager to help set workflows and tasks across the team so the right people are on the right tasks, keeping deadlines realistic and workloads manageable.
- Coach and build capability in others, setting the standard in the team by how you operate.

Campaigns & projects
- Oversee digital campaigns from concept through to delivery across multiple channels and markets, keeping brand messaging consistent and correctly targeted.
- Own digital projects from start to finish, coordinating internal and external resource, and taking accountability for delivery.
- Take ownership of a specialist digital area within the digital function, leading its plan and answering for its results.
- Join up delivery with other specialists teams, such as creative and comms.

Channels & digital operations
- Support on day-to-day delivery across the full digital mix: the brand websites, organic and paid social, paid search, email, content and UX.
- Keeping lead trackers and digital documentation accurate and making sure digital practice stays on brand and compliant with GDPR.
- Resolve and support on day-to-day issues, knowing when to escalate where a decision needs to sit above you.

Performance, Analytics and Reporting
- Analyse large data sets and translate findings into clear commercial insights and actionable recommendations for stakeholders across the firm.
- Use performance data to optimise campaigns, demonstrating ROI and year-on-year improvement against key metrics.
- Take ownership of regular reporting within your area, supporting monthly and quarterly updates for the Senior Digital Marketing Manager and Partners.

Growth and Commercial Impact
- Play a key role in campaign planning for priority sectors and service lines, identifying opportunities to maximise digital performance and commercial outcomes.
- Support business development and lead generation through digital channels, improving both the volume and quality of inbound enquiries.
- Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders, gaining a deep understanding of their objectives to deliver effective, results-driven campaigns.

Brand and Governance
- Act as a brand guardian across all digital activity, ensuring content consistently reflects the Baker Tilly brand values and messaging.
- Champion digital best practice, ensuring accessibility, compliance, and governance requirements are met.
- Contribute actively to internal marketing committees, helping to drive positive change and continuous improvement across the team.

What we are looking for
- An experienced digital marketing professional with a proven record of planning and delivering campaigns that achieve ROI.
- Well informed across the digital marketing mix, spanning web, organic and paid social, paid search and email, with the ability to adapt tone of voice for different markets and audiences.
- Experience of managing high-budget SEO and PPC campaigns, from keyword strategy and bid management through to performance tracking.
- Experience of improving customer journeys and conversion across websites, including CRO, landing page and form optimisation.
- The ability to develop and oversee complex campaigns from concept to execution.
- Some experience of line management, or the readiness and judgement to take it on and develop more junior colleagues.
- Strong commercial and analytical judgement, comfortable turning data into decisions.
- Confident with stakeholders and credible enough to influence at a senior level.
- Degree level or equivalent in a marketing or business related subject, or equivalent experience.
- A driving licence and access to a car.
- Familiarity with the digital marketing tool stack, including analytics, social management and paid media platforms.

- Ensure TikTok activity aligns with wider brand campaigns

Skills Required:
- Must have previous experience working in a similar TikTok/Content Creator/Social Media role
- Confident and engaging on-camera presence
- Experience creating TikTok, Reels, or other short-form video content
- Basic video editing skills (CapCut, Premiere Rush, etc.)
- Strong communication and presentation skills
- Commercial mindset with the ability to sell products effectively
- Self-motivated and comfortable working to a live broadcast schedule
- Experience working with retail beauty brands or haircare products
- Previous TikTok Live hosting experience
- TikTok Shop experience
- Live commerce or social selling experience
- QVC-style presenting background
- Existing TikTok following
- Experience analysing content performance metrics

This role is best suited to a commercially minded content creator who enjoys being on camera and can combine entertaining content with sales-driven live commerce.

title: Receptionist
description: Multiple vacancies have arisen for a motivated and enthusiastic person to work for the Walk in Centre team across the 4 Liverpool Sites; City Walk In, Smithdown Walk In, Garston UTC and Old Swan UTC. They will be customer focused and provide a comprehensive service. Communication and organisational skills are essential. Multiple vacancies full-time and part-time available. They must have excellent inter personal skills, and be able to organise and prioritise their work schedule. They must be able to work on their own initiative, with excellent telephone manner and respectful confidentiality. Previous experience is desirable . They must also be willing to work across all sites as required. You will be required to cover sickness and absence. The service is open daily 8am to 8pm including Bank Holidays (including Xmas Day), and weekends, and shifts are allocated according to service needs. The post holder will provide reception and administrative duties to ensure the smooth day to day running of the work environment. Work with colleagues in establishing and maintaining administrative procedures to promote patient satisfaction, respecting the confidential nature of information relating to the Trust, its staff and patients. To participate in training and development programmes both internal and externally. Ensure the delivery of the quality strategy within the designated area incorporating establishment of systems and processes. Receive and direct patients and visitors on arrival at the centre, providing reception services for patients, staff, public, internal and external customers and organisations ensuring sensitivity when dealing with distressing situations. Answering telephone calls using the switchboard system receive and process incoming and outgoing telephones calls, taking messages and responding appropriately to maintain effective communication channels. Sorting and distribution of mail to all departments. Manage and maintain stock levels and ordering supplies. Accurately record new and follow up attendances on the electronic appointment system, updating and revising information where necessary. Assisting with the collection of data and statistics to produce standardised computer generated reports and/or statistical information for managers as and when required. Maintain filing systems and other records as required ensuring they are up to date and accurate and implement changes to systems and procedures as directed. To participate in meetings as required. To ensure a professional approach to work maintaining confidentiality throughout. Generally monitor security within the building. Ensuring reception and waiting areas are kept clean, tidy and safe. Report and record sickness, absences and any incidents or accidents in accordance with Trust Policy. Staff may be required to work from other bases within the organisation.

title: Receptionist/Administrator
description: Working Hours: The position is for a full or part-time role with shifts taking place between the hours of 7:45 AM and 6:45 PM Monday to Friday. Job Type: Part-time or Full-time About the Role: Are you looking for a rewarding role where you can make a difference to patients' lives while working in a supportive and friendly team? Ford Medical Practice is seeking an enthusiastic, motivated and compassionate individual to join us as a Receptionist/Administrator. This varied role combines front-line reception duties with dedicated administrative responsibilities, allowing you to develop a broad understanding of general practice operations. The successful candidate will provide excellent customer service to patients whilst also supporting the administrative functions of the practice. The ideal candidate will have excellent communication skills, a professional telephone manner and the ability to manage multiple tasks efficiently. Previous experience in a GP practice would be advantageous but is not essential, as full training will be provided. Flexibility to provide cover for colleagues during periods of annual leave and sickness is essential. Reception Duties Manage and maintain the practice appointment system. Respond to patient enquiries, either in person or by telephone. Direct patients to the most appropriate service or healthcare professional. Process prescription requests in accordance with practice procedures. Register new and temporary patients and update patient records. Ensure the reception area is welcoming, tidy and professional. Maintain patient confidentiality at all times. Administrative Duties Accurately enter and maintain patient data within the clinical system. Process incoming correspondence and action items appropriately. Support clinical and management staff with routine administrative tasks. Liaise with hospitals, community services and other healthcare organisations as required. Undertake document management, scanning and filing tasks. Assist with other administrative duties as required. Key Skills & Qualities: Strong face-to-face communication and interpersonal skills Professional and friendly telephone etiquette Commitment to maintaining patient confidentiality Proficiency in IT and the ability to learn new systems quickly Ability to remain calm and composed in a fast-paced environment Flexible and adaptable to changes in shift patterns and team needs Ability to work independently and as part of a team Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail Previous experience in primary care is an advantage, but not required Greet patients, visitors and other callers to the practice in a professional, courteous and welcoming manner. Respond to telephone enquiries from patients, healthcare professionals and external agencies, directing calls appropriately and taking accurate messages when required. Manage appointment bookings, cancellations and amendments using the practice's clinical system. Support the practice's care navigation and triage processes by gathering relevant information from patients in accordance with practice protocols. Respond to patient enquiries and requests, seeking advice from clinicians or senior colleagues where appropriate. Register new and temporary patients and maintain accurate patient demographic records. Arrange interpreting services when required. Provide patients with test results and other information in accordance with practice procedures. Assist clinicians and the wider practice team with administrative and operational tasks as required. Act as a chaperone during clinical examinations when appropriately trained and requested. Maintain a tidy, professional and welcoming reception and waiting area. Undertake opening and closing procedures, including security checks and alarm procedures where required. The successful candidate will undertake dedicated administrative sessions to support the efficient running of the practice. Duties may include: Processing repeat prescription requests in line with practice protocols. Monitoring incoming workflow and clinical administration tasks and ensuring they are actioned promptly or directed to the appropriate team member. Processing patient registrations and deductions. Updating and maintaining accurate patient records, including demographic and clinical information as instructed. Processing incoming correspondence, scanning, coding and filing documents as appropriate. Managing electronic documents and workflows within the clinical system. Liaising with hospitals, community services and other healthcare organisations regarding patient enquiries and administrative requests. Supporting recall programmes and other practice administrative initiatives. Undertaking general administrative duties to support clinicians and the management team. Patient Care and Communication Deliver a high standard of customer service to all patients, carers and visitors. Communicate with empathy, professionalism and respect, particularly when dealing with sensitive or challenging situations. Keep patients informed of any delays or changes to appointments where possible. Work collaboratively with clinicians, colleagues and external healthcare professionals. Contribute positively to a supportive team environment. Information Governance and Confidentiality Maintain strict patient confidentiality in accordance with data protection legislation, NHS guidance and practice policies. Comply with GDPR, Caldicott principles and information governance requirements. Ensure all patient information is handled securely and appropriately. Maintain awareness of safeguarding responsibilities and practice procedures. IT and Record Keeping Accurately record and update information within the clinical system and other practice software. Develop and maintain competence in EMIS Web, Accurx, PATCHS, Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel and any other systems required for the role. Ensure all data entry is accurate, timely and completed to a high standard. Quality, Training and Development Participate in team meetings, training sessions and practice development activities. Identify opportunities for service improvement and raise suggestions with line managers. Undertake mandatory training and maintain personal and professional development. Support the induction and training of new staff where appropriate. General Responsibilities Comply with all practice policies and procedures. Follow Health and Safety, COSHH, infection prevention and control, and fire safety requirements. Maintain the security of the premises, staff and patient information. Undertake any other reasonable duties consistent with the nature and grade of the post, as requested by the Partners, Practice Manager or other members of the leadership team. Other Information This job description is intended to provide an overview of the duties and responsibilities associated with the role. The post holder may be required to undertake other reasonable duties commensurate with the role to meet the changing needs of the practice and its patients.

title: Receptionist and Administrator
description: We are looking for a Receptionist to join our friendly, hard-working and forward-thinking team. We have Two full time vacancies based at Riverside Centre for Health L8 6QP and Picton Medical 137 Earle Road L7 6HD The ideal candidate will have excellent customer service and communication skills and be able to work as part of a team. Previous experience of working in a GP practice is desirable but not essential. This is an exciting time to join our organisation. This role is integral to our approach to patient care, both face to face, virtually and on the telephone. The successful candidate will: Offer assistance to the team and project a positive image to visitors, either in person, online or on the telephone. Assist and direct patients in accessing the appropriate service and/or healthcare professional in a courteous and efficient way. Undertake a variety of administrative duties in the smooth running of the practice. Processing/issuing of prescriptions. Maintaining our appointment system. Processing requests for appointments, visits and consultations and ensuring callers are directed to the appropriate professional. Processing/distributing mail. Various administrative duties - scanning, read coding, completing tasks and summarising patient records. Computer data entry/data allocation and collation. Initiating contact with/responding to requests from patients. Filing and retrieving paperwork. Clearing and restocking consultation rooms. Keeping patient areas tidy and free from obstructions. Job title: Medical Receptionist/Administrator Reports to: Practice Manager Hours: Full time position available (hours on rota basis between 8am to 6.30pm as per contract of employment) Job summary: The purpose of the role is to: Offer general assistance to the practice team and project a positive and friendly image to patients and other visitors, either in person, online or on the telephone. Receive, assist and direct patients in accessing the appropriate service or healthcare professional in a courteous, efficient and effective way. Undertake a variety of administrative duties to assist in the smooth running of the practice including the provision of secretarial and clerical support to clinical staff and other members of the practice team where needed. Facilitate effective communication between patients, members of the primary health care team, secondary care and other associated healthcare agencies. Duties and responsibilities: The duties and responsibilities to be undertaken may include any or all of the items in the following list. Duties may be varied from time to time under the direction of the senior GP or your Supervisor dependent on current and evolving practice workload and staffing levels: Knowledge and use of EMIS web Processing and issuing of prescriptions within standard timeframes as per practice policy Maintaining and monitoring the practice appointment system Processing personal and telephone requests for appointments, visits and telephone consultations and ensuring callers are directed to the appropriate healthcare professional Processing and distributing income (and outgoing) mail using Workflow Taking messages and passing on information Admin duties including scanning, read coding, completing tasks and summarising patient medical records Computer data entry/data allocation and collation; processing and recording information in accordance with practice procedures Initiating contact with and responding to requests from patients, other team members and associated healthcare agencies and providers Filing and retrieving of paperwork Clearing and restocking consultation rooms as required Monitoring of fridge temperatures Providing clerical assistance to practice staff as required from time to time, including word/data processing, filing, and photocopying Keeping patient areas tidy and free from obstructions and clutter Being polite and helpful to patients and colleagues at all times ensuring that you provide good customer service and make a good impression Confidentiality: In the course of seeking treatment, patients entrust us with, or allow us to gather, sensitive information in relation to their health and other matters. They do so in confidence and have the right to expect that staff will respect their privacy and act appropriately. In the performance of the duties outlined in this Job Description, the post-holder may have access to confidential information relating to patients and their carers, practice staff and other healthcare workers. They may also have access to information relating to the practice as a business organisation. All such information from any source is to be regarded as strictly confidential. Information relating to patients, carers, colleagues, other healthcare workers or the business of the practice may only be divulged to authorised persons in accordance with the practice policies and procedures relating to confidentiality and the protection of personal and sensitive data. Health & safety: The post-holder will assist in promoting and maintaining their own and others health, safety and security as defined in the practice Health & Safety Policy, to include: Using personal security systems within the workplace according to practice guidelines Identifying the risks involved in work activities and undertaking such activities in a way that manages those risks Making effective use of training to update knowledge and skills Using appropriate infection control procedures, maintaining work areas in a tidy and safe way and free from hazards Reporting potential risks identified Equality and diversity: The post-holder will support the equality, diversity and rights of patients, carers and colleagues, to include: Acting in a way that recognises the importance of peoples rights, interpreting them in a way that is consistent with practice procedures and policies, and current legislation Respecting the privacy, dignity, needs and beliefs of patients, carers and colleagues Behaving in a manner which is welcoming to and of the individual, is non-judgmental and respects their circumstances, feelings priorities and rights . Personal/professional development: The post-holder will participate in any training programme implemented by the practice as part of this employment, such training to include: Participation in an annual individual performance review, including taking responsibility for maintaining a record of own personal and/or professional development Taking responsibility for own development, learning and performance and demonstrating skills and activities to others who are undertaking similar work . Quality: The post-holder will strive to maintain quality within the practice, and will: Alert other team members to issues of quality and risk Assess own performance and take accountability for own actions, either directly or under supervision Contribute to the effectiveness of the team by reflecting on own and team activities and making suggestions on ways to improve and enhance the teams performance Work effectively with individuals in other agencies to meet patients needs Effectively manage own time, workload and resources. Communication: The post-holder should recognise the importance of effective communication within the team and will strive to: Communicate effectively with other team members Communicate effectively with patients and carers Recognise peoples needs for alternative methods of communication and respond accordingly.
